justification: Both surfaces show shallow incised stone relief organised around a vertical axis with horizontal bands and at least one prominent concentric disc placed near the centre, which is the most specific correspondence. Otherwise they diverge sharply: A is a flat, densely populated narrative panel of seated human figures, glyph-like blocks and a scrolled border, whereas B is a massive three-dimensional standing figure whose rear surface bears only a few sparse, weathered curvilinear and circular motifs.
